## G. W. F. Hegel on truth

G. W. F. Hegel (1770–1831) approaches truth within German idealism. Reality is intelligible as dialectical development: contradictions in limited standpoints drive Aufhebung—cancellation and preservation at a higher level. Spirit (Geist) comes to know itself through history, culture, and institutions. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets truth most directly—useful for searches such as “g. w. f. hegel quotes on truth.”
